events.Title: Compsoc Screenings: Mr. Robot
events.Location: Meeting Rooms 1 & 2, Áras na Mac Leinn
events.Description:
We thought since a lot of our members look at computers all day that we would do something a bit different.

Starting Monday 5th October 2015 in the Meeting Rooms (Áras na Mac Léinn), CompSoc will be showing the full 10 eposide season of Mr. Robot.
The series is based on a young, anti-social computer programmer Elliot who works as a
cybersecurity engineer during the day, but at night he is a vigilante
hacker. He is recruited by the mysterious leader of an underground group
of hackers to join their organization. Elliot's task? Help bring down
corporate America, including the
company he is paid to protect, which presents him with a moral dilemma.
Although he works for a corporation, his personal beliefs make it hard
to resist the urge to take down the heads of multinational companies
that he believes are running -- and ruining -- the world.

To kick the showings off, Mr. Robot will start every Monday starting 5th of October for 5 weeks showing 2 eposides each Monday. An excellent, breath-taking show which will have your eyes glued to the screen and at the edge of your seat!

Matching in with Mental Health week, Elliot is afraid and reluctant to ask for help from his friends and the show illustrates how important it is to talk and enjoy life to the full!
It is based around Ethical Hacking which matches a major issue worldwide at Global week, which also kicks off the same week.
This show is truely awesome and is not to be missed. Whether you are fascinated with technology or not, you will truely enjoy this show.

Free pizza and a bit of a laugh for those that come.

Date: Wednesday 12th July
Time: 10am - 1pm
Location: 18 Distillery Rd, NUI Galway (Bungalow beside Security).

PCs are recorded and a certificate of wiping of its hard drive will be provided by Camara.

Computers are used in Education in Ireland and in Africa.

Usable Desktop Computers, Flat Screen Monitors, USB Keyboards and USB Mice are welcome.

Please note CRT monitors, printers and projectors are not accepted.

For more information:

http://camara.org/give-computers/
https://www.facebook.com/nuigcompsoc

More information:
• Each hard drive is erased using a US Department of Defence (DoD 5220.22-M) and NIST 800-88 compliant program that operates on a firmware level, making it impossible to retrieve any data.
• If the hard drive fails during wipe it is physically removed, degaussed and crushed.
• Data destruction service can alternatively be provided at customer’s site location for more than 50 Hard Drives.

Talk on Deep Learning from Hugh Leather
events.Description:
Cancelled
Talk title:
Deep Learning for Compilers

Abstract:

Writing optimising compilers is difficult. The range of programs
that may be presented to the compiler is huge and the system on which
they run are complex, heterogeneous, non-deterministic, and constantly
changing. Machine learning has been shown to
make writing compiler heuristics easier, but many issues remain.

In this talk I will discuss recent advances in using deep learning
to solve compiler issues: learning heuristics and testing compiler
correctness.

Bio:

Hugh is a reader (associate
professor) at the University of Edinburgh. His research involves all
elements of compilers and operating systems, usually targeting
performance and energy optimisation, often with a focus
on using machine learning for those tasks. After his PhD, also at
Edinburgh, he was a Fellow of the Royal Society of Engineering. Before
returning to academia, he was an engineer at Microsoft and architect and
team leader at Trilogy, delivering multi-million
dollar projects to Fortune 500 companies.

events.Description:
PyCon is an annual conference all about Python. It takes place on the 16th of November in the Radisson Blu Royal Hotel, Dublin. Tech conferences are one of the best ways to up-skill and learn about the industry, and Python is one of the most versatile languages around. Whether your passion is in machine learning, web development, cloud computing, scientific programming, or cyber-security, there's something for you!!

Tickets are only €25 - 50% of your transport and entry fees are covered by the society. Your ticket gets you:
• Transport to and from the venue from Galway

• Entry to the event
• Access to all talks, workshops, and other activities
• Free breakfast and lunch at the event
We'll be departing at 6:15AM and returning at 8:45PM, so you're getting a full day for the price! And if you're still on the fence, here's some of the talks going on this year:
• Pythonising Government AI
• Exploring the Milky Way with astropy, matplotlib and Gaia.
• Vector Voodoo: Unleashing the Magic of Vector Databases with Python.

• Full schedule can be found at: https://python.ie/pycon-2024/schedule/
This is a great opportunity to experience the best of Ireland's tech culture, and at a fraction of the price you'd pay yourself!! Places are limited, so make sure to get your name down ASAP.

events.Title: Linux Installation Workshop - Windows 10 EOL
events.Description:
Windows 10 support is ending, but your laptop still has plenty of life left!
Join us for a one-hour guided session where we’ll help you install Linux Cinnamon Mint — a familiar, Windows-like desktop that’s easy to use, fast, and free from annoying updates, AI assistants, and proprietary bloat.
What to Expect
In this workshop, we’ll:
• Walk you through installing Cinnamon Mint from USBs we’ll have preloaded with the latest ISOs
• Help set up Wi-Fi, drivers, and essential software
• Give a quick tour of the Cinnamon desktop and its helpful tools, like an intuitive start menu, modern file manager, and built-in system utilities
• Show you how to try a live boot so you can test Cinnamon Mint without making any changes to your laptop
What to Bring
• Your laptop and charger
• Your files already backed up — we’ll be wiping drives!
Cinnamon Mint is fast, reliable, and designed to feel familiar while keeping things simple and clean. A friendly, quick way to retire Windows and enjoy a modern, fuss-free desktop!

Automate Everything: Zero Code Required!
Join us for a hands-on workshop where you'll discover how to build powerful automations without writing a single line of code! We'll dive into n8n, the open-source automation platform that connects all your favorite apps and services.
What You'll Learn:
• Set up your own automation server using Docker (we'll make it easy!)

• Build real workflows that actually save you time

• Connect APIs, webhooks, databases, and hundreds of apps with drag-and-drop simplicity

• Automate everything from Discord bots to data scraping to AI-powered workflows

Whether you want to scrape Canvas for assignments, automatically organize your files, send yourself notifications, or build the next great student hack - n8n makes it possible without the coding headache.
No prior experience needed. Bring your laptop, and leave with superpowers.

events.Title: Intersocs Quiz 2025
events.Description:
Join CompSoc, Horror Soc, and TimeLord for our fifth annual Intersocs Quiz, the one night of the year where chaotic trivia, questionable confidence, and cross-society rivalry collide.
Grab three friends (or three people who simply won’t abandon you under pressure) for a team of 4. You’ll battle through rounds ranging from the surprisingly doable to the “who on earth knows that?” end of the spectrum.
Prizes await the victorious trivia champions, so bring your A-game.

You can get tickets here or at the door (as long as they don't sell out!) for only €5!

• Time: 19:00–21:00

Featuring a quick intro to n8n, an open-source workflow automation platform that connects apps and services using a visual, node-based interface to automate repetitive tasks. We’ll walk through building a quick RSS-to-email workflow.

We’re happy to announce our special event for Computer Science Week: the Bot Coding Challenge!
This fun competition gives participants the chance to build their own bots and have them compete against each other. The theme will be announced on the day.
